meta.landingTitle: Tipper — card tips for small cafés and shops
meta.landingDescription: Tipper lets guests tip small coffee shops and neighbourhood shops by card. Scan a QR code or tap NFC, pay with Apple Pay or Google Pay, and the tips reach your bank account at the end of the day.

hero.title: Tips by card, for the places that never had them.
hero.text: Tipper helps small coffee shops and neighbourhood shops get tipped by card. No terminal, no app, no setup. Guests scan a code or tap a tag, and the day's tips reach your bank account at the end of the day.

problem.title: Fewer people carry cash. Fewer people can tip.
problem.text: Restaurants can add a tip to the card payment. Small coffee shops, bakeries, kiosks and corner shops usually can't, because they have no waiter, no tip option on the terminal, and no easy way to take one. So guests who would happily say thank you simply can't, and the people who made their morning go home with less.

points.title: Guests want to tip
points.text: A good coffee deserves a thank-you, but nobody has coins in their pocket any more.

points.title: Card terminals don't help
points.text: Most small places have a terminal built for the exact bill, with no way to add a tip.

points.title: Staff lose out
points.text: Tips that used to arrive in a jar are quietly disappearing.

solution.title: Tipper fixes that — fully digital.
solution.text: No hardware to buy, no app to install, no new terminal. Just a small sticker or tag by your till.

how.title: From “thank you” to your bank account, in four steps.

steps.title: Put up your Tipper code
steps.text: We give you a QR sticker and an NFC tag with your own unique link. Stick them by the till, on the counter or on the cup sleeve.

steps.title: The guest scans or taps
steps.text: They point their phone camera at the QR code, or just tap the NFC tag. Your tip page opens instantly, with no app to download.

steps.title: They pay in two taps
steps.text: They choose an amount and pay with Apple Pay or Google Pay. No card numbers to type.

steps.title: You get paid at the end of the day
steps.text: All of the day's tips are transferred to your bank account, with a clear record of every tip.

why.title: Built for small places, not for big restaurants.

items.title: Easy access
items.text: QR code and NFC: any modern phone can use it in seconds, with no account and no app.

items.title: Nothing to install
items.text: No terminal, no cables, no software. A sticker is all it takes.

items.title: Secure payments
items.text: Guests pay with Apple Pay or Google Pay, so card details are never typed in or stored by you.

items.title: Paid every day
items.text: The day's tips go to your account at the end of the day, so there is nothing to collect or count.

items.title: Simple and fair
items.text: We keep only a small share of each tip to run the service. The rest is yours.

items.title: Fully digital
items.text: No cash jars and no counting coins. Every tip is recorded and accounted for.

about.title: Who we are
about.text: We are a small local team that believes good service deserves a thank-you, even when there is no cash in the wallet. Tipper started with a simple question: why can you tip a waiter by card, but not the person who makes your morning coffee? We built the answer, and we help small places everywhere get it set up.

contact.title: Want Tipper at your place?
contact.text: Write to us and we'll get you set up with your own QR code and NFC tag.
